title: Post-Series A: Strategic Pivot Decision
description: You've raised $5M, have 14 months of runway, and are not hitting growth targets. Model the decision to pivot vs. double-down vs. wind-down — including the impact on team retention, investor confidence, and future fundraising.

decision.prompt: Choose your strategic direction with $5M raised and growth stalling.

options.label: Adjacent pivot — new ICP, same core product
options.description: Keep the technology but target a different buyer or use case where you've seen unexpected traction. Preserves most of the team and product investment while changing distribution.

options.label: Double down — cut costs and stay the course
options.description: Reduce burn by 40% through layoffs and extend runway to 24+ months. Bet that the current market will mature and distribution will improve with more time.

options.label: Pursue acqui-hire or strategic acquisition
options.description: Engage strategic buyers while the team and technology still have value. Likely a below-valuation exit, but returns some capital to investors and provides soft landing for the team.

remaining_runway_months.label: Remaining Runway (months)
remaining_runway_months.description: Months of runway before cash out at current burn rate.

team_size.label: Current Team Size
team_size.description: Full-time employees — affects restructuring costs and execution capacity.

current_arr_usd.label: Current ARR ($)
current_arr_usd.description: Annual recurring revenue at the time of the pivot decision.

arr_growth_rate_monthly.label: Monthly ARR Growth Rate
arr_growth_rate_monthly.description: Current monthly ARR growth rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.04 = 4% MoM).

investor_bridge_probability.label: Bridge Round Probability
investor_bridge_probability.description: Estimated probability current investors will provide a bridge round if needed.
